rawContent: A large protest march is taking place on Franklin Street, Chapel Hill, NC. As far as I can tell, it’s 100% masked and socially-distanced. I’m walking with 50 surgical masks to give out as necessary, but haven’t encountered a single person without a mask. 💪#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/dWyVb6RO6j

It’s a good-sized march for the town of Chapel Hill. Note how people look as if they’re not keeping distance ahead, even though they are. Just a photo effect. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/jfhrZuK97f

I don’t know of a dashboard of what’s going on elsewhere, but my little corner of the U.S. is still having #blacklivesmatter marches almost daily. No indication people are disregarding the pandemic though, all masked and distanced. “Racism is a pandemic, too.” https://t.co/Lo2bvbwTwj
